name: financial-portfolios-ai
description: Google Vertex AI & Gemini Extension for quantitative model portfolios, target asset allocations, and model alignment arithmetic from Financial Portfolios AI. Informational only under publisher exclusion.

tools.name: get_portfolio_allocation
tools.description: Retrieve current or historical target allocation snapshot and risk metrics.

tools.name: get_portfolio_history
tools.description: Retrieve historical allocation snapshots over a custom time window.

tools.name: rebalance_portfolio
tools.description: Calculate mathematical model alignment arithmetic (share quantity differences) for user holdings.

tools.name: get_rebalance_template
tools.description: Download holdings CSV template (max 200 rows, 512 KB).

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Search and list published quantitative research articles.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Retrieve full content of a research article.

tools.name: get_token_info
